what: The AlphaEvolve repository of problems (google-deepmind/alphaevolve_repository_of_problems, 67 problems, arXiv:2511.02864): the pages of its first ten world-record problems (1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 30, 32 per status.json) and the listing of its experiments folder, fetched 2026-10-02 at commit 8f447457957d, for the pre-registered corpus of 100 machine claims. The pages are JavaScript templates whose statements load at runtime; the constructions, where published as objects, live under experiments/ at the same commit and are fetched when a row is decided — a problem published only as a program is NEEDS DATA, because claimant code is never run here.
